difficultyReason: Embedding a React component (Excalidraw) inside Svelte 5 required building a custom cross-framework bridge using $effect() and createRoot(). Also involved full auth flows (email verification, password reset, OAuth), Drizzle ORM with PostgreSQL via Docker, and real-time auto-save on the canvas.

Integrating GraphQL queries with the AniList API, implementing Tailwind CSS for styling, client-side favorites persistence, and building a full i18n system across all pages. Routing and data fetching patterns differ from traditional SPAs.
Primarily a frontend-focused project with component composition and routing. No backend, auth, or database complexity — mainly UI replication and layout work.
Each animation is a standalone demo — no complex state management, auth, or data flow. The challenge lies in the variety of animation techniques rather than architectural complexity.
